title: Tree with Weak Parent Links
hints: Trace the counts. The caller holds `root`; `child->parent` also holds `root`. When the caller lets go, `root`'s count drops to 1, not 0. The child keeps the parent alive and the parent keeps the child alive, so neither count ever reaches zero and `Tracked::alive` stays at 3.

Change the member to `std::weak_ptr<Node> parent;`. Assigning a `shared_ptr` to it still works, but it does not count. To read it you need a temporary owner: `auto p = n->parent.lock();` which is an empty `shared_ptr` if the parent has already been destroyed.
